## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## 💡 Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.

## 🛠 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution or architectural implementation you would like to see.

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📊 Impact & Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or mockups about the feature request here.
